proposed_decision.rule: Resolve each locked slot's concept directly from the approved semantic blueprint, then generate 2-3 candidate G-ID forms per slot using semantic-first, G-ID-first, Phonotactic Profile V2 and collision-review contracts. Generation produces review options only.

governance_decisions.proposal: Use NATIVE_PRIMITIVE_CANDIDATE as default lane; do not infer productive morphology from -VAN, final -I, PAR-, VAM-/VAMA-, SAR- or prior lexical families.

Each option must expose slot ID, blueprint concept reference, G-ID sequence, IPA, governed romanization only, phonotactic notes, exact-collision result, near-collision result and morphology-false-friend result.
Reject exact collisions against 33 recovered forms and all 100 authored registry entries through Wave 02; near collisions require explicit review.
This gate resolves no HOLD seed and creates no semantic authority beyond the already approved blueprint slots.
After generation prepare a separate Wave 03 human selection gate. No option receives registry status, HNK3000 credit, FROZEN authority, curriculum binding or runtime use before later gates.

approval_rule: A future SIGA may approve only DEC-HNK3000-W03-GEN-001 through DEC-HNK3000-W03-GEN-006 if this gate remains materially unchanged. The same SIGA must not select or register generated forms, assign HNK3000 credit, promote authority, resolve HOLD seeds, approve B16, or alter L03 curriculum/runtime.
